@view.cancel.description: Button that closes a picker or dialog without choosing.

@view.done.description: Button that confirms a picker's choice.

@view.ok.description: Button that confirms an alert or dialog.

@view.previousMonth.description: Date picker button that shows the month before.

@view.nextMonth.description: Date picker button that shows the month after.

@view.hour.description: Time picker column of hours, read by screen readers.

@view.minute.description: Time picker column of minutes, read by screen readers.

@view.period.description: Time picker column choosing morning or afternoon on a 12-hour clock.

@view.options.description: Accessible name of a list of choices that has no label.

@view.dialog.description: Accessible name of a dialog that has no title.

@view.actions.description: Accessible name of an action sheet.

@view.error.failed.description: Shown for a failed call whose error has no more specific word.

@view.error.network.defaultMessage: Can't connect. Check your connection and try again.
@view.error.network.description: Shown when a call failed because the network is unreachable.

@view.error.timeout.defaultMessage: This is taking too long. Try again.
@view.error.timeout.description: Shown when a call gave up waiting.

@view.error.permission.defaultMessage: This needs your permission. You can allow it in Settings.
@view.error.permission.description: Shown when the person or the system declined a permission the call needs.

@view.error.unsupported.defaultMessage: This isn't available on this device.
@view.error.unsupported.description: Shown when the device or platform cannot do what was asked.

@view.error.notFound.description: Shown when what the call refers to does not exist any more.

@view.error.limit.defaultMessage: You've reached a limit. Try again later.
@view.error.limit.description: Shown when a quota or rate limit stopped the call.
